{{Quote|Less tax equals more profit.|Raymas Daal, presenting the attack as motivated by profit to conceal his Trade Federation allegiance|<ref name="SI" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] took an early step towards their planned [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] through an '''attack''' on a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]]. Trade Federation operative [[Raymas Daal]] planned the attack by hiring a group of agents whom he met with at a Kwilaan [[Kwilaan restaurant|restaurant]].

After dealing with three [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Security Officer|officers]] who had tailed Daal, the agents headed to the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] the following [[Standard day/Legends|night]]. There, they encountered four [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]] and two [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], overcoming all of them to deactivate the array. The Trade Federation used the opportunity to place [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] around Naboo, which they would later use to sever Naboo's communications when they began the invasion.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Let's make this quick, I think I was followed.|Raymas Daal, during his meeting with the agents|<ref name="SI" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] planned to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and then [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Prior to beginning the blockade, the Trade Federation planned to disrupt Naboo's communications by launching covert operations on several [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]].<ref name="SI" /> Small-time [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal [[Raymas Daal]] was contracted by Trade Federation agents to covertly disrupt [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] arrays to allow the Trade Federation to place [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] without detection. He was also given [[Currency/Legends|funds]] to hire freelance agents to disrupt the arrays,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|160|Daal, Raymas}}</ref> including one near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]].<ref name="SI" />

{{RPGseed}}
Daal&mdash;known for his reliability&mdash;arranged a meeting with a group of financially constrained agents in a [[Kwilaan restaurant]].<ref name="SI" /> At the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], the agents found that Daal had not arrived, and they were on the verge of leaving when he appeared, hoping to conclude the meeting quickly under the assumption that he had been followed. Daal offered 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the group to temporarily deactivate the sensor array for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], claiming that he hoped to get a shipment of rare [[Spice/Legends|spices]] past the array and earn a greater profit through avoiding taxes.<ref name="SI" />

[[File:Sensor_array_map.png|thumb|right|350px|The entrance to the sensor array]]
After questioning from the agents, Daal explained that they would need to deactivate the array the following [[Standard day/Legends|night]], at which point he would detect the deactivation and land his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] inside Kwilaan. The group asked questions about the assignment and was given enough information to find the array. The conversation came to a halt when three plainclothes [[Security Officer]]s of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] arrived, planning to take Daal in for questioning for his suspected Trade Federation connection. The Human leader of the group asked Daal to come with him, but instead of answering, he jumped out of his seat and fled to the rear exit. The [[Officer/Legends|officers]] fired at Daal, with one of them turning their [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] toward the agents. After dealing with the officers, the agents made their way to the sensor array the following night as planned.<ref name="SI" />

==The attack==
After arriving at the array, the agents knocked out the four [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]] there and dealt with the two [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] at the array so that they could deactivate it.<ref name="SI" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Do you think she suspects an attack?''"<br />"''I don't know, but we must move quickly to disrupt all communications down there.|[[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] and Nute Gunray, following a transmission with Naboo [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
With their mission complete, the Trade Federation was able to place their jamming satellites, and the agents planned to track down Daal to claim their reward.<ref name="SI" />
{{Endgame}}

Daal was eventually detained by the Royal Naboo Security Forces for questioning.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Trade Federation later began their blockade, surrounding Naboo with [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class freighters]].<ref name="TPM" /> After a [[Standard month/Legends|month]],<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> the Trade Federation began landing on Naboo in response to the [[Mission to Naboo|presence]] of Jedi ambassadors. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered all of Naboo's communications to be immediately disrupted.<ref name="TPM" /> They made use of their jamming satellites<ref name="SI" /> and [[Subjugation of Parrlay|attacks]] on [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] in several Naboo cities<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> to isolate the planet from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Signal_Interruption_title.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The attack is the main focus of the scenario "Signal Interruption."]]
The attack on the Kwilaan sensor array constitutes the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' scenario "[[Signal Interruption]]," written by [[Jesse Decker]], illustrated by [[Adam Hughes]], and published on the ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' website on [[August 9]], [[2001]]. "Signal Interruption" is designed to be completed with the game pieces from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'' and is written with the assumption that the group is heroic with sympathies that lie toward the Naboo while also providing suggestions for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] characters. Players have the option to use the existing playable characters from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'' with few changes: [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Toba]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]].<ref name="SI" />

"Signal Interruption" consists of three encounters. The first one involves the players meeting with Daal, and it suggests that if players present a reluctance to take Daal's job, he may raise the price as high as 10,000 credits. The second encounter involves the fight with the three Security Officers in the restaurant, where the players can choose how to fight them off, with the suggestion that dark side players will be able to quickly resolve the encounter by drawing their weapons as soon as the officers draw their blasters.<ref name="SI" />

The attack on the sensor array itself takes up the third encounter. The players have the choice to either sneak up on the guards or directly begin shooting at them. The scenario describes the technicians inside the array as unlikely to attack unless provoked and that even if attacked first, they are more likely to flee unless their exit is blocked. The scenario suggests that players could continue the story in the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'' or that the game master could create original adventures involving Daal and his secret backers. "Signal Interruption" specifies that groups with heroic characters could work towards undoing the damage they caused, while dark side characters could continue working for the Trade Federation, possibly coming to the attention of the Trade Federation's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] benefactor,<ref name="SI" /> [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="TPM" /> This article assumes that the events of "Signal Interruption" occurred as described in the text.
